selection: Leave one of the eight original training readers out; maximize equal-reader mean Recall@1; ties prefer larger alpha. No outer validation selection.
preprocessing: Fit word-coordinate standardization and 16-component non-whitened PCA on inner-training words only; fit final feature median imputation and standardization on inner-training sentences only. Refit on all eight training readers after selection.
gaussian: Training-word column mean/SD only; regenerate per fold; preserve exact word counts and missingness masks. Same model and search as ordered_real.
order_control: Permute finite word EEG vectors among finite slots within each sentence; missingness slots and sentence word count remain unchanged.
pooling: Four disjoint np.array_split bins over source word order; average available projected words per bin, zero if no valid words; append four finite-word fractions. Mean baseline uses one bin and the same fitted word projection.
mask_control: Four per-bin finite fractions plus total word count, overall valid fraction and training-derived word-count basis; no EEG amplitudes.
structural_control: Existing first 14 count/duration summaries; rebuild count basis on each inner-training fold.
validation_policy: One post-selection evaluation of each frozen arm on existing 512-query/298-candidate cohort; repeatedly reused validation, explicitly exploratory, not fresh confirmation.
screen: ordered_real must beat mean_real and every control on aggregate Recall@1 and MRR, and exceed Gaussian and structural Recall@1 for each validation reader; descriptive screen only.
test_policy: Never read test source files, extract test features or score test observations; stop after validation regardless of outcome.
duration_units: Source TRT durations are sample counts at 500 Hz, used only by structural control; no fixation onset or physical temporal spacing is invented.
